purpose: Measure structural repair of productive requests, constraints, ellipsis, correction, result queries, and affect/request contrast on fresh non-V3 surfaces.
structural_repairs: A unique compositional frame may fill one lexically unbound theme without replacing the operation or erasing other ambiguity.
Operation inheritance is typed separately from historical result queryability through operation_replayable.
Withdrawn operations cannot be reactivated by ellipsis.
Retarget, constraint continuation, and operation ellipsis outrank overlapping carrier verbs without granting execution authority.
Native and legacy projections cannot overwrite a one-goal intent/subject disagreement silently.
Result-content questions are separated from verification-status and plan-only boundaries.

decision.reason: The repaired boundary is fully passing on fresh development and fixed transfer suites, but completion still requires a newly sealed independent GPT-reference final evaluation.
